facts.text: I have blood in my stool.
It started one month ago.
I notice it every time I have a bowel movement.

facts.item: blood in stool: how it appears in the stool
aliases: before, during or after a bowel movement
facts.text: The blood is mixed in with the brown stool.
It's bright red.
It doesn't hurt when I have a bowel movement.
I've had diarrhea.
For the past 2 days.
Three times a day.
It's watery and brown, and it has blood in it.

facts.item: feeling you need to go but can't
facts.text: I don't feel like I have to go to the bathroom but can't.

facts.item: spasms in the back passage with an urge to go
facts.text: A little. I get some spasms down there, followed by the urge to use the bathroom.
I haven't seen any mucus in my stool.
My stool isn't black.
I've had constipation.
For a long time.

facts.item: constipation: how often you have bowel movements

other_considerations.note: Most common cause of major lower GI bleeding, but usually larger-volume, discrete, self-limited bleeds.
Common cause of lower GI bleeding, but cannot explain the other features of this presentation.
Less likely given no abdominal pain and only recent onset of diarrhea and tenesmus in a month-long hematochezia.

source_issues: Many negative answers use the template 'No, I am not.', which does not fit the questions grammatically (p005, p009, p013-p017, p022, p024, p025, p030-p032); read as 'No'.

p006 'I keep taking laxatives' (present tense) conflicts with p025 'I stopped all of them when the diarrhea started' and the note ('stopped after the onset of diarrhea 2 days ago'); laxative use recorded as resolved (f033).
p009 topic is 'Urgency' but the question describes an urge without being able to pass stool (tenesmus-like); the denial sits next to p010 ('A little' anal spasm with urge) and the note's 'tenesmus'.
Note HPI 'History of constipation 6 months ago' differs from the script ('constipation for a long time'; two bowel movements a week for the past 6 months).

Note says '10-lb weight loss in 6 months despite a good appetite'; the script says the appetite 'has been the same'. Gold says 'Unintentional weight loss'; the script does not say whether the weight loss was intended.
Note PSH is in the first person ('I had hemorrhoids removed 4 years ago') and the SH says 'Sexually active with wife only'; the script says only 'With my spouse'.
The rectal exam is excluded from the examinee tasks; there are no rectal findings.
notes: Constipation is kept current (f015-f017: 'for a long time', two bowel movements a week for the past 6 months) alongside the 2-day diarrhea; the script does not say the constipation has ended.
Laxatives: f033 is the medication fact (resolved, stopped when the diarrhea started); f018 keeps the lost effect of laxatives as a present, historical treatment-response child of constipation.
p002 and p003 both describe blood mixed with the stool; f003 keeps the frequency, f004 the mixing (with both sources), to avoid a duplicate.
p021 travel: no recent travel (f039, absent) plus the planned family trip and his worry (f046), which is also listed in patient_questions.
'Married with two children' from the raw Patient Description is kept as an acting note.
leakage lists the father's colon cancer (f035) because it names the rank-1 diagnosis; the hemorrhoidectomy (f030) names the rank-2 diagnosis but is legitimate history and is not listed.
12 template answers (No, I am not.) checked against the June-2024 release: all are plain denials there; 14 facts confirmed.

Conversion: diarrhea (f007), constipation (f015), weight loss (f019) and blood in the stool (f001) are parents; duration, frequency, amount, appearance and treatment response are children, as the worked example splits 'Cocaine, once a week'.
